comparison.objective: Load, center, and focus a microscope slide without contacting the objective.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold a spring lever while inserting a slide, manipulate two stage knobs, and turn a focus knob with fine clearance control.
comparison.success_condition: Slide is clamped in the specified orientation, specimen is within 1.5 mm of the optical axis, and focus reaches the stated spacing without entering the 0.5 mm collision margin.
comparison.reason: This is the closest fine-control record, but its bimanual slide loading and multi-axis optical positioning test a different ability from recessed hex use, captive locking, collar reacquisition, and tuning repeated impacts to force/travel limits.
